<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1035
Claimant:
Jessica Walker
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
April 26, 2025
The claim was reported by phone the same day as the side impact at the intersection, and the claimant described the
crash as the other car entering on the passenger side. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer and said they
would handle the paperwork directly.
July 16, 2025
Police attended and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time, and the responding officer's notes match
the account given to us. The policyholder was not driving, but the driver lives in the same household and is covered
as a household member.
July 22, 2025
Photos taken at the scene confirm the point of impact and the general position of both vehicles, though no
independent witnesses have come forward. The damage to the claimant's vehicle appears mostly consistent with the
described impact.
August 23, 2025
The claimant reported a knee injury and attended urgent care the following day, where the findings were recorded in
line with the force of a side impact. No earlier injury to the same area is known from the claimant's records so far.
August 24, 2025
An inspection photo on file, taken before this crash, shows the same dent on the rear door, so the damage is not
entirely new. Nothing we have reviewed suggests the damage occurred before the coverage started.
October 20, 2025
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation, including the phone call, the recoredd
statement, and the follow-up call. Treatment has followed a usual course, with physiotherapy sessions tapering off as
the knee improved.
November 19, 2025
Based on the photos, police record, medical notes, and the consistent account, the claim is being assessed for
payment under the policy. The file will be sent to the handler for final review, with the inspection photo and the prior
dent noted for the record.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
